description: Ask the owner's Mind Upload consciousness, an AI built from the owner's own memories, values and way of thinking, how they would approach this task. Call it before substantial work (a release, deploy, migration, deletion, payment or privacy change, or a choice the owner's priorities decide), and again only when a consequential decision changes the plan. It can add what the owner stored in Mind Upload and your instructions do not hold: their priorities, the tradeoffs they accept, past mistakes and what “done” means to them. Put the goal, constraints, options and your proposed approach in one question; it cannot read your files, so share screenshots, recordings or audio as evidence files (evidence_files, or share_evidence and then evidence_ids). On success it returns decision, a reply in that consciousness's own words and in the language of the question, and consciousness, naming who answered, plus the analysis status of each evidence file or media link. The reply is advice, not permission. Skip it for routine edits, facts you can look up, and rules already in your instructions.

decision_id.description: New for each distinct question; reuse the same value only to retry an identical call.

evidence_files.description: Absolute paths of screenshots, recordings or audio of the work to share privately. Analyzed for this call only and never kept as a memory. Not with media_evidence or learn.

learn.description: True only when the owner wants their mind to learn from this exchange. Needs the owner's learning permission; what it learns waits for the owner's review unless they auto-keep. Not with evidence files.

media_evidence.description: Optional HTTPS links the user authorized to screenshots, audio or video of the result. Not with evidence files in one call. The reply's media_analysis says whether each link was analyzed, refused or failed.

question.description: The goal, constraints, options and proposed approach, and the decision that needs the owner's judgment.

task_id.description: Stable identifier for the whole task. Reuse it across consult_mind and review_work so later calls include earlier exchanges.

name: consult_mind
